title: LeadFlow V2 — API-Based Lead Qualification & Workflow Automation
description: Designed and engineered LeadFlow V2 as an animated API-backed lead workflow case study. An authored five-act, 24-second cinematic journey shows real server-confirmed qualification, explainable score factors, routing decisions, sandbox CRM handoff, explicitly simulated timeouts, and draft-only human approval. The interactive film supports play, pause, chapter selection, scrubbing, replay, skip, speed adjustment and reduced-motion access. A Cloudflare Pages Function supplies the actual verified event receipt, while the UI exposes a trace, JSON export and contract tests. No live external CRM write, LLM inference, or outbound message is claimed.

gallery.caption: LeadFlow V2 engineering case study — real Cloudflare edge API with documented sandbox boundaries
Qualified test lead: server-backed 96/100 score, timed event stream and local record proof
Two injected CRM sandbox timeouts and third-attempt recovery with observable trace
Explicit system responsibility and trust boundary diagram
Mobile execution view verified at 390px with no horizontal overflow
Act I: a synthetic enquiry arrives on a continuous physical arc
Act III: verified server score with explainable factors and directional staging
Act IV: two explicitly simulated sandbox timeout setbacks and recovery
Act V: the draft-only action settles into human approval
Reduced-motion accessible final state on a real 390px viewport
